thought.text: Many services still starting or failing. Let me check the process-compose logs for errors:

reasoning_content: Many services are still at 000 (not running). Let me check the logs to investigate why. Maybe migrations are still running, or the processes are failing. Let me check the process-compose log for errors.

action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== recent errors/crashes ==="; grep -inE "ERROR|Traceback|Address already|exited|stopped|Crashed|failed to start|ImportError|ModuleNotFound|Connection refused" /tmp/process-compose.log | grep -ivE "executed|GET 200" | tail -25
echo "=== seed process states (from log) ==="; grep -E "seed" /tmp/process-compose.log | tail -8
